---
title: "Mobile TOC dark scheme"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    theme:
      light: flatly
      dark: darkly
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="mobile-toc-options"']
        - []
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: node _checks/layout-check.mjs "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" dark && node _checks/axe-check.mjs "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" dark
---
